Marsh.description: Adapted to swimming through deep murky swamps and thick mud.

features.name: Marsh Tripkee
features.tldr: You gain a swim speed and ignore difficult terrain in wetlands.

Arbor.description: Specialized for leaping high up among jungle canopy branches.

features.name: Arbor Tripkee
features.tldr: You gain bonuses to Acrobatics checks and vertical leaps.
